gloss: total number; all items; complete count

definitions.gloss: total number; all items; complete count
definitions.explanation: The entire quantity or every single item in a group, with no exceptions.

examples.japanese: {全数|ぜんすう}{検査|けんさ}を{行|おこな}う。
{製品|せいひん}の{全数|ぜんすう}を{確認|かくにん}した。
{在庫|ざいこ}の{全数|ぜんすう}を{把握|はあく}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to have a grasp of the total inventory count.

examples.japanese: {不良品|ふりょうひん}が{見|み}つかったため、{全数|ぜんすう}{回収|かいしゅう}することになった。
examples.english: Because defective items were found, all units will be recalled.

notes:
{全|ぜん} (all, complete) + {数|すう} (number, count). Emphasizes that every single item is included, not just a sample or subset.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全数|ぜんすう}{検査|けんさ}: 100% inspection (inspecting every item, not sampling)
- {全数|ぜんすう}{調査|ちょうさ}: complete survey, census
- {全数|ぜんすう}{回収|かいしゅう}: total recall (of products)
- {全数|ぜんすう}{把握|はあく}: complete count/tracking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {総数|そうすう}: total number, grand total — the sum of all items counted; focuses on the resulting number rather than completeness
- {全部|ぜんぶ}: all, everything — everyday word for "all"; less formal and technical
- {全体|ぜんたい}: the whole, entirety — refers to the whole as a unit rather than counting individual items

USAGE:
Primarily used in manufacturing, quality control, public health reporting, and statistical contexts. {全数|ぜんすう}{検査|けんさ} (inspecting every item) is contrasted with {抜|ぬ}き{取|と}り{検査|けんさ} (sampling inspection) in quality management.
